meta.title: NestSelf -- employee wellbeing that works
meta.description: Psychological, legal and financial support for employees and their families, through one confidential platform. Available in Serbian, Hungarian and English.

hero.title: Support for work. And everything around it.
hero.lead: Give your employees and their families access to licensed psychologists, legal professionals and financial advisors -- all through one confidential platform.

services.title: Three areas of support, one platform
services.lead: Licensed psychologists, legal professionals and certified financial advisors, available online and in person.

items.title: Therapy & Counselling
items.body: Licensed psychologists and psychotherapists for individual, couples and family sessions -- online or in person.

items.title: Legal Consultation
items.body: Confidential guidance on personal legal matters -- family law, tenancy, consumer rights.

items.title: Financial Guidance
items.body: Budgeting, debt management, savings planning and retirement guidance from certified financial professionals.

steps.title: Activate with your work email
steps.body: Your employer has already set up NestSelf for you. Sign in with your work email to see what is available.

steps.title: Choose an area and a time
steps.body: Pick therapy, legal or financial support. Browse available professionals and find a time that suits you.

steps.title: Talk, in your language
steps.body: Have your session in Serbian, Hungarian or English -- online or in person. Your employer never sees who used the service or what was discussed.

steps.title: Keep going with follow-ups and the library
steps.body: Book follow-up sessions, explore self-help tools, read articles and join webinars at your own pace.

employers.title: A wellbeing benefit your team will actually use

life.title: Support for the people around you

items.question: Who can use NestSelf?
items.answer: Any employee whose employer has activated the NestSelf programme. Where the employer's plan includes family coverage, partners and children can also access the service.

items.question: Is it confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR receives only anonymised, aggregated reports when the group is large enough to prevent identification -- a minimum of 10 people.

items.question: What does it cost employees?
items.answer: Nothing. NestSelf is a benefit paid for by your employer. You access therapy, legal and financial support at no cost to you.

items.question: How fast can we launch?
items.answer: Most organisations go from signed agreement to employee access in two to four weeks. We provide a communications toolkit to help you announce the programme.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: Sessions are available in Serbian, Hungarian and English. The platform interface and all content are available in all three languages.

items.question: What if someone is in crisis?
items.answer: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call the emergency number now. Serbia: 112 (emergency), 194 (ambulance). Hungary: 112 (emergency), 104 (ambulance). NestSelf also provides guidance on accessing urgent professional support.
